issues.title: Brief: a newsletter
issues.body:
## Decision needed
Go: a monthly note to people who ask for one.

## Who it is for
People who found the site and want to follow the team without checking back.

## What it is
A one-line form under the footer: a visitor leaves an email address. Once a month the founder sends a short note on what the team built.

## Appetite
Two days.

## Technical decisions
None.
